title: Title & Registration Services Late-Penalty Reimbursement: Share Reimbursed When the Buyer Contributed to the Delay
content:
On a Title & Registration Services late-penalty reimbursement, the reimbursement is the reimbursable penalty multiplied by the reimbursed share. When the buyer missed the first scheduled handover and the order's first submission came after the handover, the reimbursed share is the penalty's total days late less the buyer's handover delay days, never below zero, divided by the penalty's total days late; when the buyer did not miss a handover in that way and the state returned the order for a document from the customer, the reimbursed share is the penalty's total days late less the buyer's correction days, never below zero, divided by the penalty's total days late; otherwise the reimbursed share is the whole reimbursable penalty, a share of one. Both divided shares apply only while the penalty's total days late are more than zero.

## Terms on the records

- **The buyer missed the first scheduled handover**: the handover appointment under Delivery & Pickup Appointments shows customer unavailable as the cause of its most recent missed attempt.
- **The buyer's handover delay days**: the calendar days from the first scheduled handover date (the appointment date first booked) to the actual handover date on the purchase order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, never below zero.
- **The first submission came after the handover**: the order's first submission date (the date its title fee was remitted to the state) is later than the handover date.
- **A return for a document from the customer**: a state rejection entry for a missing signature, insurance not verified, emissions not on file or an odometer discrepancy.
- **The buyer's correction days**: the calendar days from the order's most recent return that needed a corrected document from the customer to the date the order's latest document was received, when that document arrived after the return; nothing otherwise.

## Decision table

| Buyer missed first handover and first submission after handover | Return for a customer document on the order | Reimbursed share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | total days late less handover delay days (not below zero), divided by total days late |
| no | yes | total days late less correction days (not below zero), divided by total days late |
| no | no | one |
| total days late are zero | | one |

## Worked examples (hypothetical, total days late 20)

- First scheduled handover 5 June missed as customer unavailable; handed over 11 June; first submission 20 June. Handover delay days 6; share 14 divided by 20, that is 0.7. On a reimbursable penalty of 10.00 the reimbursement is 7.00.
- No missed handover; returned for a missing signature on 2 July; latest document received 10 July. Correction days 8; share 12 divided by 20, that is 0.6.
